rca_unanticipated: Bank Indonesia surprise rate hike to 5.5% announced after market open
Labor protests at PT Molex Ayus affecting sentiment
Global market shock narrative (e.g., heightened risk aversion) emerging later in the day
rca_overestimated: Risk of a sharp oil price rebound above $80/bbl, which did not materialise (oil actually fell ~0.7%)
rca_underestimated: Impact of the BI rate hike on the rupiah (IDR weakened to 17,828) and on equity sentiment, contributing to a 0.98% drop in IHSG
rca_info_delay: BI rate hike announcement released after the 08:30 briefing cutoff
Labor demo news surfaced mid‑morning, after the brief was compiled
rca_inverse_correlation: The brief assumed neutral sentiment would keep the market flat, but the unexpected rate hike and rupiah weakening drove a bearish move despite oil prices staying low
lessons: Ketika tidak ada data ekonomi domestik atau global yang signifikan (kondisi pagi netral), tetapi BI secara mendadak menaikkan suku bunga, maka IHSG turun 0.98% dan rupiah melemah 0.04%.

Ketika pasar diperkirakan netral karena tidak ada faktor utama, tetapi terjadi aksi demo buruh dan sentimen risiko global meningkat, maka tekanan jual tambahan memperdalam penurunan indeks menjadi -0.98%.
summary: Prediksi netral tidak terbukti; BI rate hike, aksi demo, dan sentimen risiko global menekan IHSG turun 0.98% meski oil tetap bearish.
